# Unified Reading

> A personal reflection web app at https://unifiedreading.com/ that synthesizes numerology, Western astrology, the Chinese zodiac, and life-stage context.

Unified Reading helps a person explore themes across three interpretive traditions in one reading. The free public sample requires no personal data. To create a personal reading, the visitor enters a birth name and date, optionally a birth time and place, and selects current life stages. The site calculates profile values in the browser and uses OpenRouter model providers to write the unified interpretation. A free preview is shown first. The full reading costs $4.99, paid once through Stripe Checkout, with no subscription, and can be downloaded right after paying. See [pricing](https://unifiedreading.com/pricing.md).

## When to use

Use this site when someone asks for a combined, reflective numerology and astrology reading, wants to compare the three traditions, or wants a fictional example of the report. Do not describe the reading as a scientific assessment or a deterministic prediction. Houses and the chart ruler are calculated (whole sign) only when a birth time and place are given. Do not infer Moon, rising, houses, aspects, or current transits when the app does not provide them.

- [Home and reading wizard](https://unifiedreading.com/): Product overview and entry point.

- [Privacy](https://unifiedreading.com/privacy): Data processing, provider routing, caching, and payment details.
- [Pricing](https://unifiedreading.com/pricing): Current cost and scope of the full reading.
- [Contact](https://unifiedreading.com/contact): Public issue tracker and private payment support guidance.

## Library

Plain-language guides to the three traditions, each with a short answer, key facts calculated from the app's own tables, and a markdown version at the same URL plus `.md` (for example https://unifiedreading.com/life-path/1-vs-9.md). The pairing guides compare whole signs, numbers and animals; they do not describe planetary aspects or transits, which the app does not calculate.

- [Library index](https://unifiedreading.com/library): All guides and calculators.
- [Numerology basics](https://unifiedreading.com/numerology): The Pythagorean chart, core numbers and master numbers.
- [Life Path numbers](https://unifiedreading.com/life-path): Meanings for 1-9, 11, 22 and 33, and all 45 Life Path pairings.
- [Zodiac signs](https://unifiedreading.com/zodiac): Elements, modalities, ruling planets and Sun sign dates.
- [Zodiac compatibility](https://unifiedreading.com/compatibility): All 78 Sun sign pairings, without scores.
- [Astrology basics](https://unifiedreading.com/astrology): Sun, Moon and rising, whole sign houses, and what the reading does not calculate.
- [Chinese zodiac](https://unifiedreading.com/chinese-zodiac): The twelve animals, Lunar New Year boundaries, elements and yin-yang.
- [Chinese zodiac compatibility](https://unifiedreading.com/chinese-zodiac/compatibility): All 78 animal pairings through San He, Liu He, Liu Chong and Liu Hai.
- Calculators, all in the browser with no data sent: [Life Path](https://unifiedreading.com/life-path-calculator), [zodiac sign](https://unifiedreading.com/zodiac-sign-calculator), [Chinese zodiac](https://unifiedreading.com/chinese-zodiac-calculator).
- [Library answers and facts](https://unifiedreading.com/llms-full.txt): Each published page's answer and key facts in one file.

## Limits

There is no public API for submitting someone else's birth details. Ask the person to use the site's form directly; never put sensitive birth or payment information in a public GitHub issue.
